mapper.insert: insert into course (course_num, grade, name, teacher, college, major, course_time, course_room, credit, total_capacity, selected_count, remaining) values (#{courseNum}, #{grade, typeHandler=com.student.server.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{teacher}, #{college, typeHandler=com.student.server.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{major, typeHandler=com.student.server.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{courseTime}, #{courseRoom},#{credit}, #{totalCapacity}, #{selectedCount}, #{remaining})
mapper.select: select id, course_num, grade, name, teacher, college, major, course_time, course_room, credit, total_capacity, selected_count, remaining, gmt_created, gmt_modified from course

select id, course_num, grade, name, teacher, college, major, course_time, course_room, credit, total_capacity, selected_count, remaining, gmt_created, gmt_modified from course where 1=1
limit #{currentIndex}, #{param.pageSize}

select count(*) from course
AND JSON_CONTAINS(grade, JSON_ARRAY(#{grade}))
AND JSON_CONTAINS(college, JSON_ARRAY(#{college}))
AND JSON_CONTAINS(major, JSON_ARRAY(#{major}))

select id, course_num, grade, name, teacher, college, major, course_time, course_room, credit, total_capacity, selected_count, remaining, gmt_created, gmt_modified from course
AND JSON_CONTAINS(grade, JSON_ARRAY(#{grade}))
AND JSON_CONTAINS(college, JSON_ARRAY(#{college}))
AND JSON_CONTAINS(major, JSON_ARRAY(#{major}))
limit #{currentIndex}, #{param.pageSize}

select id, course_num, grade, name, teacher, college, major, course_time, course_room, credit, total_capacity, selected_count, remaining, gmt_created, gmt_modified from course where course_num=#{courseNum}
mapper.update: update course set selected_count = selected_count + 1, remaining = remaining - 1 where id = #{courseId} and remaining > 0
update course set selected_count = selected_count - 1, remaining = remaining + 1 where id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: select id, course_num, grade, name, teacher, college, major, course_time, course_room, credit, total_capacity, selected_count, remaining, gmt_created, gmt_modified from course where id=#{courseId}
